organism: Mercurialis annua, diploid wind-pollinated annual plant

experiment.allocation_morphs: Continuum from pure female through intermediate allocation to pure male, reduced vegetative sex dimorphism

fitness_estimands.male_paternity: nine-microsatellite markers assign seed father; source sampled ~6.6% of produced seeds
fitness_estimands.female_reproduction: mature seed number discounted by estimated selfing rate times hypothetical inbreeding depression
fitness_estimands.whole_lifetime: Annual plants permit authors to approximate annual lifetime seed gene transmission, but seed viability conditional on assumed depression

published_observations.reason_for_qualifier: Delta 0 vs 1 imposed analytically. Actual diploid inbreeding depression unknown. Absence of ancillary sexual dimorphism does not mean no male/female sex allocation specialization.

biological_limit: The inferred strong disruptive selection on sex allocation for medium/large plants is CONDITIONAL on assumed delta=1; this study does not observe natural historical establishment of dioecy.
cross_source_independence: Independent genus and wind pollination from Pulsatilla and Cyananthus, not a replicated experiment with shared estimands.
